data.name: Cheesty
data.detailed_description:
ABOUT THIS GAME

You are no ordinary rat. As the smartest experiment in the laboratory—with a scar to prove it—you are about to execute the ultimate escape plan.

In Cheesty, the human world becomes a gigantic playground filled with equal parts wonder and peril. From high-security labs to your final destination (the legendary rodent paradise you’ve heard so much about), you must use your agility, instincts, and the very tools of your captors to outsmart security and break your way into the outside world.

KEY FEATURES

  • Rodent Wits: Is a scientist blocking your path? Look closely at your surroundings—the environment is your greatest ally.

  • Infiltration & Stealth: Hide in the shadows, crawl through pipes, and learn enemy patrol patterns. A single misstep will alert the staff.

  • Superior Sniffing: Use your sense of smell to guide your path and discover unique collectibles. Though... it won't always be that easy.

  • Dynamic & Varied Levels: Master classic platforming jumps and movements tailored specifically for a rat, and survive frantic alternate sections where you must outrun other dangers.

  • Art with Personality: Immerse yourself in a unique visual narrative through pre-level comic strips inspired by high-contrast comic book art, creating an unforgettable atmosphere of danger and adventure. This, paired with a distinct hand-painted visual style and an original soundtrack composed entirely in-house, ensures an unrepeatable experience in every single level.

ALL THIS AND MUCH MORE AWAITS YOU IN CHEESTY!!!

data.short_description: Step into the paws of a bold lab rat on a desperate escape to freedom. Leave your scars and past behind using your wits: manipulate the environment, use makeshift tools, and sniff out the right path to the exit in this chaotic stealth, puzzle, and platforming adventure.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 or AMD FX-8350
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti or AMD Radeon RX 570 (4 GB VRAM)
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-10700 or AMD Ryzen 7 3700X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 SUPER or AMD Radeon RX 6600 (8 GB VRAM)
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
